root_cause.text: The bridge's NS/NA suppression code used compile-time check IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_IPV6) instead of runtime check ipv6_mod_enabled(), allowing the code to run even when IPv6 is disabled at boot, dereferencing the uninitialized nd_tbl (NULL) and causing a NULL pointer dereference in neigh_lookup().
root_cause.evidence: CVE description states that with ipv6.disable=1, nd_tbl is never initialized; the patch replaces IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_IPV6) with ipv6_mod_enabled() in both br_device.c and br_input.c to avoid running suppression when IPv6 is disabled.
